title: Ayush Shetty Stuns Defending Champion Shi Yu Qi at Worlds
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Ayush Shetty delivered a massive upset by defeating the defending world champion, thrilling Indian fans.
summary: Ayush Shetty defeated world champion Shi Yu Qi 21-14, 13-21, 21-19 in a thrilling BWF World Championships match, showcasing his skill and determination.

title: Indian Shuttlers Navigate Tricky Worlds Conditions; Lakshya, Unnati Advance
indian_angle: This report covers the mixed fortunes of several Indian players, including Lakshya Sen and Unnati, at the ongoing World Championships.
summary: Indian shuttlers faced challenging conditions at the BWF World Championships, with Lakshya Sen and Unnati advancing, while an unnamed Indian doubles pair experienced a heartbreaking loss.

title: Sindhu Cruises to Victory at Worlds, Aims for Sixth Medal
indian_angle: PV Sindhu, a beacon of Indian badminton, began her World Championships campaign with a dominant win, eyeing a historic sixth medal.
summary: PV Sindhu secured a commanding 21-7, 21-11 victory over Sophia Noble in her opening match at the BWF World Championships, setting her sights on a record sixth medal.

title: Ashmita Rebuilds Career, Wins Maiden BWF World Tour Title
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita shares her journey of overcoming injury and sponsorship loss to win her first BWF World Tour title, inspiring many.
summary: After falling outside the top 200 and losing sponsorship, 26-year-old Indian shuttler Ashmita rebuilt her career, returning to the country where she was injured to win her maiden BWF World Tour title.

title: Junior Team Coaching Camp Underway for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This news highlights the ongoing efforts to train India's promising young badminton talent at the National Center of Excellence for upcoming Asian championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is currently being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.
